verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is an agentic video-production tool, so letting users plug in MCP servers for extra tools is a fair axis. The evidence never mentions MCP or any way to register external tool servers. Running on the user's own Claude Code or Codex is a host-platform capability, and the 'Extending' section covers styles, rendering engines and other AI backends, which is adjacent rather than MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
